definition_zh: n. 发生( occurrence的复数形式 ); 出现; 事件; 发生的事

definition_zh: n. 成本计算, 成本会计

definition_en: Involving financial matters

definition_en: Someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts

definition_en: Pl.  of Currency
definition_zh: n. 通货( currency的名词复数 ); 货币; 流通; 市价
examples: The new policy addressing currencies was debated extensively by the committee.

Market liquidity evaporated rapidly during the sudden credit panic.
